picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it one of the largest single awards in the initiative, concentrating major DOE AI-for-science funding and multi-institution partnerships.

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's selection to lead six projects and partner on 17 others shows the Genesis Mission's reach into nuclear-security and defense-adjacent research, broadening its strategic footprint beyond pure academic science.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others
